name: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire
look: A bald man with a thick black mustache, white shirt and tan jacket stares wide-eyed in shock on a dark blue game show set. Across the lower half is the quiz-show graphic: a long empty question box above four answer boxes labeled A, B, C and D.
use: A fake quiz question. Write a question in the long box and four answers in the A to D boxes, usually three normal choices and one absurd or painfully relatable one. The man's shocked face reacts to the question.
slots: the question (long box under his face)
examples: What do you do when your alarm goes off?
Turn it off and wake up at noon
Which of these is a vegetable?
